description: SPIKE golden: recursive-compositional unfold of a DEPTH-2 PARALLEL chain (base + F1 + F2 folded off F1's free edge with a PARALLEL bend axis -- a Z / offset). Same tree walk as the corner case; F2 still composes THROUGH F1's already-flattened placement, but the two parallel fold axes develop as a 1D strip. Proves the recursion covers the parallel depth-2 chain too (the case the shipped depth-1 unfold defers, docs/design/sheet-metal.md sec 4.3). Isolated spike, not the shipped unfold.
tangent_line_convention: Legs to the bend TANGENT LINE (sec 9 #1). Base 30 (Y) + BA + F1 leg 25 + BA + F2 leg 15 stack along dev-Y; all flanges full-width 40 along dev-X.
derivation: HAND-DERIVED (independently recomputed in the test). Dims: base 40x30; F1 leg 25 width 40; F2 leg 15 width 40 (folds off F1's full free edge, so its width matches F1's 40, NOT the corner case's 25); t=2, r=3, both 90deg, K=0.44.

Developed placements: base dev-Y [-15,15]; F1 one BA beyond -> [21.0947, 46.0947]; F2 one BA beyond F1 -> [52.1894, 67.1894]. A monotone 1D stack (all axes parallel), each flange full-width 40 in dev-X [-20,20]. Per-flange developed area == 3D face area (isometry residual 0.0); BA-strip offset residual ~3e-15.
Envelope: flat_length (dev-X) = 40; bend_width (dev-Y) = 30 base + (BA+25) F1 + (BA+15) F2 = 82.18937949592839 mm.
Outline: three developed rectangles = 12 body edges + 2 fold lines. Both bends 'up'.
content_hash = sha256 of FlatPattern.to_json_bytes() -- determinism pin, in-process AND fresh-restart reproducible (sec 9 #4).
tolerance_rationale: Measured residuals same class as the corner golden: developed-area residual 0.0, BA-strip offset ~2.7e-15, envelope ~1e-12. Ceiling 1e-9; volume tolerance 1e-6.
